chunks: Habib ibn Aws, Abu Tammam, al-Ta'i. I saw an ancient manuscript that might have been written for him in his time or close to it. In it, there is a poem mentioning the Imams (peace be upon them) until it reaches Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him), because he died during his time.

key_terms.أَبُو تَمَّامٍ: Abu Tammam, the kunya (nickname) of the narrator
key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِي: Abu Ja'far the Second (Imam Musa al-Kazim)
key_terms.حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ: Habib ibn Aws, a specific narrator

ai.seo_question: What evidence exists regarding the lifespan of Habib ibn Aws and his connection to Imam Musa al-Kazim?
ai.summary: This biographical note from 'Kitab al-Du'afa' describes an ancient manuscript attributed to the narrator Habib ibn Aws (Abu Tammam). The manuscript contains a poem that lists the Imams, concluding with Abu Ja'far al-Thani (Imam Musa al-Kazim), indicating that the Imam died while Habib was still alive.
